title: Tool_call deltas omit the `index` field entirely (Gemini OpenAI-compatibility endpoint)
source: Google AI Developers Forum: 'Gemini OpenAI compatibility issue with tool_call + streaming' (2025-01, unfixed as of 2025-11)

anomalies.note: delta.tool_calls entries omit required `index` field (all chunks); single-call stream is recoverable by inferring index 0

expected.note: A diagnostic must report the missing index at the stream-parse layer instead of crashing (KeyError 'index' observed in source case) and instead of silently accepting the stream. Recovery-by-default is only safe for a single call; the same shape with multiple calls must be reported as unrecoverable (see f4).

failureModeIfBuggy: Consumers that key on `index` crash (KeyError) or drop every tool_call; silent acceptance hides a wire violation that becomes unrecoverable the moment parallel calls appear.
mutationHooks: Add a second tool_call with distinct id and no index — expected verdict must flip to unrecoverable, proving the fixture checks call-count-dependent recoverability, not just absence of index.
specBasis: OpenAI Chat Completions streaming: each delta.tool_calls entry carries `index` identifying which call the fragment extends.
Google forum thread documents the upstream omission persists across model generations (user quote, 2025-11: index field still not emitted).
notes: Reconstructed from the forum thread's chunk descriptions and user workarounds (sniff model name, hardcode index=0). Same wire defect class independently observed in litellm #21331 bridge and ollama #15457 — see candidates list §1.
